profile.title: Profile
profile.avatarInvalidType: Unsupported image type — use JPEG, PNG, or WebP.
profile.spoilerProtectionDescription: Blurs episode stills, titles, and overviews you haven't watched yet, and show/season descriptions until fully watched. Click any blurred item to reveal it just for that view.
profile.onDeckFillGapsDescription: Continue Watching normally only shows the episode right after the latest one you've watched. Turn this on to also surface an earlier episode you skipped.

plex.description: Paste this URL into your Plex server's Settings → Webhooks (requires Plex Pass). Watches will start logging automatically.
